  "detect_remove_q04_seed42:/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/detect_remove_q04_seed42/final"
)

  "openwebtext:/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/data/eval_openwebtext.jsonl"
  "wikipedia:/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/data/eval_wikipedia.jsonl"

  IFS=':' read -r exp_id ckpt_path <<< "$ckpt_entry"
  echo "=========================================="
  echo "OOD eval for: $exp_id"
  echo "Checkpoint: $ckpt_path"
  echo "=========================================="

  for data_entry in "${OOD_DATA[@]}"; do
    IFS=':' read -r data_name data_path <<< "$data_entry"
    output_file="/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/eval_results/${exp_id}_ood_${data_name}.json"

    if [ -f "$output_file" ]; then
      echo "  SKIP: $output_file already exists"
      continue
    fi

    echo "  Running: $data_name"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python eval_perplexity.py \
      --checkpoints "$ckpt_path" \
      --data_path "$data_path" \
      --max_docs 5000 \
      --output_path "$output_file"
    echo "  DONE: $data_name -> $output_file"
  done
  echo ""
done

echo "ALL OOD EVALS COMPLETE"
SCRIPT
